main_evaluation.label: main
main_evaluation.embedding_applies_to: Every automated configuration that queries the corpus, including fixed-heuristic-warm.
run_settings_recorded_at_pre_run_freeze: roles and writer token and time limits
role and writer prompt versions and route fingerprints
main_evaluation.actual_version_rule: The requested model ID is openai/gpt-6.1-sol. Every call records the model version the API reports. The pre-run freeze records the version reported by the bounded smoke check. If any held-out call reports a different version, or no version, it is listed as a deviation with the affected runs; it is never silently accepted or replaced.

excluded.reason: Historical v1 Anthropic planner settings. Not used by any main-evaluation configuration; its fallbacks setting does not apply to the main evaluation.

unavailable_metadata_rule: A field the provider does not return is recorded as not_reported, never guessed, and the count of not_reported fields is published with the results.

optional_experiments.status: No alternative route or model experiment declared for protocol 1.1.0.
rules: An experiment is declared here, with a protocol version bump, before it runs.
Its label starts with exp- and its results are stored and reported apart from the main evaluation; they never enter the main tables.
It states the requested model, the routing settings (fixed provider order, fallbacks off), the required capabilities, the data policy, the cases, the repetitions and the spend allowance.
Each call records the requested and reported model, the serving provider and endpoint when returned, routing settings, retries, fallbacks, gateway fees and latency; anything missing is not_reported.
Automatic model substitution stays off. A run that the gateway served with another model is reported as a deviation, not as a result for the requested model.
